question: The procedure for eliminating nitrogenous waste with use of an artificial kidney is referred to as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**haemodialysis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Artificial Kidney was first introduced by William J.Kolff in 1943.__
 
• Dr. Willem Kolff is considered as the father of dialysis.
 
• He is a Dutch physician constructed the first dialyzer named artificial kidney in 1943.
 
• The First Artificial Kidney has been oriented in India by Dr. Shuvo Roy and his team at the University of California in America. 
 
• Kidney & Bladder: 
 
 
• The kidneys are characterized as two bean-shaped organs in our renal system.
 
• They help our body pass waste materials as urine.
 
• The kidneys perform many vital functions, including maintaining overall balance fluid, regulating, verifying & filtering minerals from the blood, etc.
 
• The urinary bladder is a muscular part in our pelvis, just behind and above the pubic bone.
 
• When the bladder is about the shape and size of a pear, then the Urine is made in the kidneys and travels towards the two tubes called ureters to the bladder. The bladder stores the urine and to allowing urination to be controlled & infrequent.
 
• Our kidneys act as a filter to remove the waste materials and the extra fluid of our bodies.
 
• Your kidneys filter almost 200 quarts of blood every day to create about one to two quarts of urine.
 
• This prevents the buildup of waste materials and fluid to keep your body healthy & wealthy.
 
 
 
• Diseases from Kidney: 
 
 
• The meaning of Kidney disease is that your kidneys are damaged and can't work or filter our blood the way they should. You are at greater risk for kidney disease if you have high blood pressure & high diabetes. some other kidney problems that are are kidney injury, kidney cysts, kidney stones, and kidney infections.
